metadata.title: doc-converter | Private document and image converter
metadata.description: Convert PDF, DOCX and images on our own servers in the EU

footer.tagline: A secure SaaS converter for documents and images. Server infrastructure is located strictly in the EU.
footer.bottomNote: SSE-KMS encryption • ClamAV antivirus • No data shared with third-party AI

home.title: Private document and image conversion
home.subtitle: Accurate OCR for printed text, DOCX to PDF export and image processing on our own isolated servers in the EU.

eu.title: 100% isolation in the EU
eu.text: Files are never sent to third-party AI services. All processing runs on our own hardware in EU data centres.

ocr.title: OCR accuracy up to 98%
ocr.text: PaddleOCR models deliver a CER of 2% or less on clear scans while preserving tables, lists and paragraphs.

cleanup.title: Auto-cleanup after 12 h
cleanup.text: Guest session files are guaranteed to be deleted 12 hours after completion. Results are encrypted with SSE-KMS keys.

pdfToDocx.title: Convert PDF to DOCX
pdfToDocx.subtitle: High-accuracy optical character recognition (OCR) hosted on proprietary EU servers, preserving headings, lists, tables, and layout.

docxToPdf.title: Convert DOCX to PDF
docxToPdf.subtitle: Reliable Word document export to standardized PDF via headless LibreOffice with exact typographic fidelity.

imagesToPdf.title: Convert Images to PDF
imagesToPdf.subtitle: Merge or convert JPG, PNG, and static WebP images into standardized A4 sheets with 10 mm margins and automatic orientation.

pdfToImages.title: Rasterize PDF to Images
pdfToImages.subtitle: Page-by-page rendering to JPG or WebP on clean white backgrounds with customizable 72, 150, or 300 DPI and quality controls.

imagesToPdf.a4StandardInfo: Each image is placed on an individual A4 sheet with 10 mm margins. Proportions are preserved and transparency is filled with pure white.

pdfToImages.dpiInfo: Selected DPI and quality apply uniformly to all selected pages in the batch.
pdfToImages.qualityDesc: Value: {quality} (default 85 — optimal balance between quality and file size)
